_comment: Questions for tools/assistant_eval/run.py. 'must' are regular expressions (case-insensitive) that ALL have to match the answer; they check the key fact, not the wording. 'kind' is 'name' when the question names a register, instruction or format, 'concept' when it describes what the user wants without naming it. Facts come from the Stella Programmer's Guide and the knowledge base (data/kb); keep them checkable.
